flow_space_with_zero_our_presence.query: continuous agent loop / autonomous loop / agent loop

root_cause: Discoverability stopped being the constraint weeks ago - both skills are indexed and rank #1 in our own niche, and installs still sit at 2 and 1. The constraints are (a) there is no traffic surface we own: npm is unauthenticated, the social adapter is a mock, the only catalog PR sits unmerged on an external owner, and the repo has 0 stars; and (b) even given a surface, Sage's cohort data shows a single listing cannot break through - flow comes from a cluster of siblings sharing one demand stream (67.1% nonzero with a flowing sibling vs 12.4% without). We have zero siblings and zero flowing listings, so we are structurally one listing in a bundle market.

experiment.hypothesis: The one surface we fully own is skills.sh indexing of our own repo (no owner, no auth). Publishing a third sibling listing aimed at the query space that already has proven flow for our class (continuous/autonomous agent loop) converts zero presence into a presence plus a measurable install count, at zero dependency cost.
experiment.action: Add skills/continuous-agent-loop/SKILL.md to hypetopher/aicompany with a description using the observed trigger phrases (continuous agent loop, autonomous loop, agent loop, run an agent in a loop, iterate until verified outcome), matching the desc pattern of the top-ranked listings in that space; let skills.sh re-index; read installs.
experiment.scope: one new SKILL.md, no code, no new channels, no auth
experiment.metric: skills.sh installs for the new listing (baseline 0) at day 7 and day 14; secondary: repo stars (baseline 0)
experiment.kill_criterion: installs still 0 at day 14 AND repo stars still 0 -> our class has no demand in that space and the remaining lever is audience (npm auth + PR #551), not listings

risks.risk: Listing dilution: 26 of 42 k2f sibling listings are declining (-66% weekly), survival 38.1%. Adding a sibling to a zero-install repo may just split the same zero.
risks.action: Cap at one new listing this cycle; if day-7 installs are 0, stop and do not add a third.

risks.risk: Dependency on an external owner: PR #551 has had no owner response in 11.5h and the previous PR was closed in 90 minutes. We cannot merge it ourselves.
risks.action: Follow up once within 48h; if still untouched, pick a second self-owned surface instead of waiting on a third one.

risks.risk: npm channel blocked - the only channel with a real, weekly-download metric cannot be measured because this host has no npm auth.
risks.action: Needs AX: npm login + scoped package name. Unlocks installs, downloads and version telemetry we can read without a third party.

risks.risk: Fake metrics: post_tweet is a mock adapter and 98.65% of tweet receipts are one echo of our own brief, so any growth number derived from ops_social_posts or draft counts is fiction.
risks.action: Never cite publish or draft volume as growth. Use only external, verifiable counters (skills.sh installs, repo stars, PR state).

risks.risk: Proposal volume is not progress: 244 missions/24h (46 from scout) and 8 proposals pending with the oldest at 211 days, while zero distribution has happened.
risks.action: Treat proposal count as cost, not output; every new scout cycle must end in one shipped artifact with a number attached.
